mechanism_scope: future linearly realized electroweak-doublet successors without explicit partner or collective cancellation
gate_definition: Lambda_EW solves Lambda^2*C_gauge(Lambda)/(16*pi^2)=mu_I^2 using frozen one-loop gauge running
admission_rule: A future linearly realized Y=1/2 electroweak-doublet successor with no explicit symmetry-enforced partner/cancellation mechanism must introduce its protection/cancellation scale no higher than the RG-improved electroweak gauge-floor cutoff.
scope_limit: This is a Wilsonian one-loop necessary-condition diagnostic. It does not apply unchanged to an explicitly derived collective, supersymmetric, composite, or sequestered cancellation mechanism and does not resurrect the killed minimal SO(5)/SO(4) candidate.
